title: CompareRequest
description: The same meal evaluated under exactly two participant contexts.

ContextOverride.description:
Optional pre-meal context supplied by the caller instead of being read from
stored history. Every field is optional and defaults to `null`, in which case the
server derives that value from history truncated at `meal_timestamp`.

IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE: the master specification fixes this field as present and
nullable but does not enumerate its members. This object is the v1.0 definition.
It is additive-only; new members require a contract bump.

Server-side guard: any supplied `as_of` strictly later than `meal_timestamp` is
rejected 422 `future_context_override`. The override can never be used to inject a
post-meal observation.

premeal_glucose_mg_dl.description: Overrides the measured baseline glucose at minute 0.

recent_heart_rate_bpm.description: Overrides the mean pre-meal heart rate feature.

minutes_since_prior_meal.description: Overrides time elapsed since the previous meal.

as_of.description:
Timestamp the supplied context was observed. Must be <= `meal_timestamp`.
Defaults to `meal_timestamp` when omitted.

MealInput.description:
Meal composition for the meal being forecast. All five fields are required by the
prediction contract (unlike an ingested `MealRecord`, where macros are optional),
because the model consumes them directly.
